grammar.summary: 本课学习表对比的 whereas 与现代分词伴随。

points.title: whereas/while 表对比
points.explanation: Modern climbers differ from early pioneers, whereas... = 然而。对比结构展示"先驱 vs 现代"的对立。

examples.en: Modern climbers are testing themselves on difficult routes, whereas the early pioneers simply went up by the easiest way.
examples.cn: 现代登山者在险峻的路线上检验自己，而早期先驱只是挑最容易的路登顶。

points.title: find oneself 表"发现自己处于"
points.explanation: They often find themselves in difficult situations. 反身结构的比喻用法：不知不觉陷入。

examples.en: It is hard for us to realize how difficult it was.
examples.cn: 我们很难意识到当年有多艰难。
